    Dear shareholders,                                                                             各位股東：

    In 2023, with the end of the pandemic which lasted three                                       在 2023 年，持續三年的疫情終於結束，國內
    years, both production and operation of domestic enterprises                                   企業恢復了正常的生產和經營，居民生活也重
    and people’s lives returned to normal. The Chinese                                             回正軌。中國政府推出了很多訪華便民措施，
    government launched various convenient measures for visiting                                   舉辦了不同的貿易展覽，強化中國與世界的經
    China, held different trading exhibitions, strengthening                                       濟合作、人文交流，努力加快疫情後經濟復蘇
    economic cooperation and people-to-people exchanges                                            的步伐。與此同時，疫情後人工智能突破式發
    between China and the globe and striving to expedite the                                       展、消費者消費模式轉變、數字經濟規模持續
    recovery pace of economy post pandemic. Meanwhile, the                                         增長。面對科技的進步和市場的變化，我們認
    artificial intelligence achieved breakthrough in development;                                  識到我們必須不斷優化經營策略、提升管理水
    consumers’ consumption model transformed; and the scale                                        平、與時俱進，才能維持我們在快速變化市場
    of digital economy increased constantly. Facing technology                                     中的競爭力。
    progress and market changes, we are aware that only by
    constantly optimizing operation strategies and improving
    management level as well as advancing with the times can we
    maintain our competitiveness in rapidly changing market.

    On behalf of the Company, I would like to share our measures                                   在此，我想和您分享集團在疫情過後採取的措
    and actions adopted after pandemic and how they improved                                       施和行動，以及它們是如何提升集團的競爭力
    the Group’s competitiveness and management capabilities                                        及管理水平的。

Dividend Policy                                                    股息政策
The Group is committed to sharing its development and              本集團致力於透過積極穩健及可持續的派息政
achievements with Shareholders through proactive, stable and       策，努力在短期的股息回報與長期的公司發展
sustainable dividend policy. The Group would strive to strike      之間達致平衡，與股東共同分享本集團的發展
a balance between the short-term dividend returns and long-        和成就。在考慮派息政策時，本集團將綜合觀
term development of the Group prudently. When considering          察宏觀經濟運行情況、行業競爭格局以及自身
the dividend policy, the Group will comprehensively observe        發展戰略，在確保本集團具備充足營運資金和
the macro-economic operation, the competition pattern of           資本性開支以落實發展戰略的前提下，將盈餘
the industry and the Group’s own development strategy.             資金派發給股東，回報股東的支持。
Under the premise of ensuring that the Group has sufficient
working capital and capital expenditure to implement the
development strategy, the Group will distribute surplus funds
to Shareholders and reward their support for the Group.
